newsitem.title: UK: Pedelty to succeed Thomas at head of Co-op Bank.
newsitem.headline: Pedelty to succeed Thomas at head of Co-op Bank.

text.p: The Co-Operative Wholesale Society (CWS) said on Wednesday Mervyn Pedelty would succeed Terry Thomas as chief executive of the Co-operative Bank when Thomas retires in October.
Pedelty, 48, will take up the post in September when he also joins the CWS executive with responsibility for financial services.
Pedelty is currently a partner in the LEK Partnership, an international firm of corporate strategy consultants and was previously a senior executive at banking group TSB.

"Financial services now play an expanding role in the CWS portfolio," said Co-op Bank chairman Alan Prescott. "Mr Pedelty's background and experience ideally equip him to develop this important area for CWS."
CWS was the subject of a highly controversial 1.2 billion stg takeover bid in April when the Co-op Bank was seen as one of the main targets.
